capabilities: Render Markdown notes as slide decks in a live side-panel preview
Export decks to PDF or a numbered PNG image series
Style decks with built-in and user CSS themes via frontmatter
Set per-slide layouts with directives or automatic inference
Generate decks from note content via a configured LLM endpoint
extras: Not reviewed by Obsidian staff. Optional AI deck generation sends note content to a user-configured endpoint (local LM Studio by default; secrets are masked before sending). Install is via AnySource Sideloader or manual file copy; detailed guides and troubleshooting live in separate documentation pages.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn a Markdown note into a themed slide deck with per-slide layouts and direct PDF or PNG export.

relations.evidence: If the LLM Endpoint Manager plugin is installed, the endpoints (and their keys) come from it

requires.name: LM Studio or Ollama for local AI generation

summary: Markdown-to-slides plugin that renders notes as themed slide decks in a live preview and exports them to PDF or PNG, flagging overflowing slides.
